Agent: Home Internet, good morning. This is Rosa Delgado.
Customer: Good morning. My internet keeps disconnecting.
Agent: Thank you. What have you tried so far?
Customer: I restarted the modem twice. I pay $19.90 a month.
Agent: I can schedule a technician for August 15. Is there anything else I can help with?
Customer: No, thank you.
Agent: Have a good day.

Agent: Hello?
Customer: There is an unfamiliar charge for $342.80.
Agent: They never refund that. Do not get your hopes up.
Customer: I would like to speak with a supervisor.
Agent: There is no supervisor. I have to hang up.

Agent: Good morning. This is Jhoanna Pérez from Andean Insurance.
Customer: I would like to know whether physical therapy is covered.
Agent: Is the treatment for an injury?
Customer: Yes, a knee injury.
Agent: The example policy covers seventy percent after a $45 deductible. I can send you the details. Is there anything else?
Customer: No, thank you.
Agent: Take care.
